label: The Main Truth
h: When a thought returns after the facts are settled, the surface subject may not be the whole issue.
body: Sometimes the mind is responding to what the situation seems to mean about your worth, your safety, your future or your trust in God.

label: The Tool · One Question, Asked Downwards
h: If this happened, what would it mean to me?
body:
If this happened, what would it mean to me?↓And if that were true?↓And if that were true?

No more than three times. Stop earlier if a fear becomes clear, nothing comes, or it gets uncomfortable.

label: Fears That Appear Again And Again
body:
Being rejectedFailingLosing moneyDisappointing peopleChoosing wronglyLosing controlGod not coming throughThe past repeating

Not for self-diagnosis. So you can recognise what you find.

label: Back To Samuel
h:
"Will the elders be happy?" cannot be settled in advance.
"Am I secure in Christ either way?" can.

label: Do This Now · Optional And Private
h: Take one thought that keeps returning. Ask once: if this happened, what would it mean to me?
body:
Ask it of your answer, up to three times. Then write: I am afraid that… or No deeper fear appeared.

Stop if it becomes too much. Then name where you are and one true thing about now. Nothing you write needs to be shared with anyone.

Pause the audio

label: Remember
h: A fear that has been named can be brought to God as a request, instead of hidden from him as a problem.

label: Prayer
body:
Search me, O God, and know my heart.

You see the fear beneath my thoughts
before I do.

I bring it to you as it is,
and I am not turned away.

Amen.
